name: Herbivory, Grazing Pressure, Seed Dispersal & Vegetation–Fauna Feedback
design_rules: herbivores consume existing plant biomass rather than abstract food
grazing pressure scales with herbivore population and intake
plants recover according to regrowth, tolerance and regional recovery
seed dispersal redistributes reproductive potential without creating mature plants instantly
fertility return improves future regrowth but does not create biomass directly
overgrazing can suppress preferred plants and shift community composition
vegetation and herbivore state persist across world days
vegetation-fauna feedback never uses emissive or glow feedback
